protocols.title: 冬枯れ
protocols.subtitle: Winter Withering
protocols.for: End of day. After long output cycles. Before sleep.

phases.label: ENTRY
phases.cue: Locate the weight in your body. Do not move it.

phases.label: DESCENT
phases.cue: Let each exhale remove one thing from the foreground.

phases.label: FLOOR
phases.cue: Nothing is required of you here.

constraints: No modification of posture during FLOOR phase
Session ends at natural completion only
protocols.setup_notes: Dim or absent light preferred. Seated or supine. No screen contact during session.
protocols.expected_effect: Reduced cortical arousal. Transition readiness. Not relaxation — departure.

protocols.title: 寒声
protocols.subtitle: Cold Voice
protocols.for: Deep work sessions. Writing. Analytical thinking.

phases.label: CALIBRATION
phases.cue: Define the one thing. Write it if necessary.

phases.label: LOCK
phases.cue: Return to the one thing. Return again.

phases.label: DEPTH
phases.cue: You are inside the problem now.

protocols.setup_notes: Seated upright. Task materials prepared before session start. Cold room preferred.
protocols.expected_effect: Sustained attention bandwidth. Reduced context-switching reflex.

protocols.title: 葉桜
protocols.subtitle: Cherry After Bloom
protocols.intent: Clearing after a completion. Making room for next.
protocols.setup_notes: Natural light if available. Standing or walking permitted during OPEN phase.
protocols.expected_effect: Cognitive reset. Reduced completion fixation. Forward-ready state.

protocols.title: 木漏れ日
protocols.subtitle: Light Through Leaves
protocols.for: Morning. Before creative sessions. Gentle reentry.

phases.label: SOFTEN
phases.cue: Nothing needs to be solved right now.

protocols.setup_notes: Natural light strongly preferred. No specific task orientation.

protocols.title: 夏陰
protocols.subtitle: Summer Shadow
protocols.for: Midday reset. After intense meetings. Thermal grounding.

phases.label: ARRIVE
phases.cue: Feel the ground beneath you completely.

protocols.setup_notes: Cool space if available. Natural ventilation. Mid-session hydration acceptable.
protocols.expected_effect: Reduced reactivity. Stable emotional baseline. Reentry capacity.

protocols.title: 落ち葉
protocols.subtitle: Falling Leaves
protocols.intent: Deep release of what is no longer needed.
protocols.for: End of cycles. Quarter endings. Major transitions.
protocols.not_for: Regular use. High frequency. Under 48hr intervals.

phases.label: INVENTORY
phases.cue: What are you still carrying that is finished?

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Hold it without judgment. Just look at it.

phases.label: RELEASE
phases.cue: Nothing needs to be done. It falls on its own.

constraints: Do not truncate RELEASE or WINTER phases
Do not use if emotionally destabilized
protocols.setup_notes: Full privacy required. 40 minutes uninterrupted. Low light. Lying down acceptable.
protocols.expected_effect: Substantial discharge of accumulated emotional weight. Not pleasant — effective.

protocols.title: 間
protocols.subtitle: The Interval
protocols.intent: Direct encounter with structured silence as material.
protocols.not_for: First sessions. Without prior FLOOR LIBRARY experience.
protocols.setup_notes: No preparation required. No guidance beyond what is given.
